range_decision.evidence: A temporary offset is visible in N/E/U between indices 692 and 701: at index 692, N jumps from ~-0.8 to ~21.3 (a large positive shift), while E and U also shift abruptly; the trajectory remains elevated for 9 samples (692–700), then at index 701 returns sharply toward prior levels (N drops to ~-2.6, E and U similarly revert).
